name: Marbled Hump
armor: Botanist+. When you successfully gather a plant resource, you gather an extra 1d4 more.
weapon: (Monk Only) Your stunning strike save DC increases by 3, but it no longer stuns. Instead, a creature that fails its saving throw is incapacitated.

name: Durambolite
armor: Survivor+. When an ally, that you can see, is reduced to 0 hit points you can use your reaction to gain +2 AC, +2 damage, and +2 to attack rolls for 1 minute. Once used, this property can't be used again until you finish a long rest.
weapon: Rust. When you hit a creature for the first time on your turn, its AC is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn.

name: P.Ludroth Scale
armor: You have resistance to cold damage while you wear this armor.

name: Rey Dau Tail
armor: Evade Extender (M). You gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws while you wear this armor.
weapon: (Spellcaster Only) This weapon has 6 runes. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its runes to cast the lightning bolt spell (save DC 15) from it. For 1 rune, you cast the 3rd-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional rune you expend. This weapon regains 1d6 expended runes daily at dawn. If you expend the weapon's last rune, roll a d20. On a 1, the runes cannot recharge for a week.

name: Ajarakan Marrow
armor: Health Boost. While wearing this armor, your hit point maximum increases by 1 for each character level you have.
weapon: Offensive Guard. Whenever you use a reaction that increases your AC, the next attack you make deals extra damage equal to the bonus AC the reaction provided.

name: T.Blangonga Whisker
armor: Taunt. When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to redirect the attack to you.
weapon: Agitator. Your weapon attacks critical hit range is increased by 1 and your weapon deals an extra 1d6 weapon damage. (This material counts as both a critical eye material and a "your weapon deals an extra damage material")
